# redact0

> Zero-dependency, MIT-licensed, <25 KB reversible PII, secret, FHIR HIPAA Safe Harbor, and streaming SSE redactor for npm and PyPI.

## Install
- JavaScript / TypeScript: `npm install redact0`
- Python (drop-in llm-guard replacement): `pip install redact0`

## Subpath Exports (npm)
- [Core API](llms-full.txt#core): `redact(input)`, `createVault()`, `scan(text)`, `Vault.fromJSON()`
- [AI SDKs](llms-full.txt#ai): `redactMiddleware()` (Vercel AI SDK v5/v6/v7), `wrapOpenAI()`, `wrapAnthropic()`, `wrapFetch()`
- [MCP Servers](llms-full.txt#mcp): `guardMcpServer(server)` for `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` v1 & v2
- [Streaming SSE](llms-full.txt#stream): `createStreamRestorer(vault)`, `createSSERestorer(vault)`
- [FHIR / HIPAA](llms-full.txt#fhir): `redactFHIR(bundle)` (Safe Harbor ZIP3, age 90+, deterministic date shifting)
- [Loggers](llms-full.txt#logger): `pinoRedactor()`, `winstonFormat()`, `redactAttributes()`
- [CLI & Built-in MCP](llms-full.txt#cli): `npx redact0 scan --sarif --fail-on-match`, `npx redact0 init`, `npx redact0 mcp`
